communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: SDSU CPRA Logs/Databases
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1 — any databases and/or spreadsheets used to track requests under the California Public Records Act from July 1, 2024 to the date of this request.
2 — any and all policy documents, manuals, memos and/or reports regarding the processing of public records requests from July 1, 2024 to the date of this request.

In the regard to the database requested in paragraph 1, please provide the database in its original electronic format pursuant to Cal. Gov. Code § 6253.9.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ed Burton

communications.subject: Connecticut Freedom of Information Act Request: Citizen Services Bureau Requests
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Record of all requests to the Citizen's Service Bureau from January 1 2023 to most recent in which the location of the requests  is in the Cove, East Side  or West Side in which the request has been open for 90 or more days or the request is closed and took 90 or more days to complete.

If these regions of the city are not available then include all requests in the 06902 area code. 

If the open or closed time information is not available then include all requests regardless of opening and closing date. 

Include the following fields or most similar field available : the data the request was submitted, the date the request was closed, the type of request, the mailing address of the request,  the current status of the request.

I also request that, if possible and pursuant to Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(d), fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest and not made for commercial gain. The requested documents will be made available to the public at MuckRock.com.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 4 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Katrina
